records.text: The scientific revolution began because of a long organized Freemasonic effort to remove humanity from its innate spiritual understanding.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And indeed, I would agree that it is modern science. In fact, the entire thrust of what was deemed the scientific revolution, a move away from the natural order of things and towards empiricism, rationality, that began because of a long organized Freemasonic effort to remove humanity from our innate spiritual understanding.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 5:45. The chronology directly contradicts the claim: the Royal Society dates to 1660 and the Scientific Revolution was already underway, while organized modern Freemasonry is conventionally dated to about 1717. Scholarship finds later overlap and influence, not that a long Freemasonic campaign began the Scientific Revolution.

sources.title: History of the Royal Society
sources.relevance: Dates the Royal Society to 1660 within the scientific revolution, before organized Grand Lodge Freemasonry.

records.text: Freemasons worship Solomon as the master architect and believe he gave them the keys to build and control societies.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 13:39. Masonic sources describe Solomon's Temple as a central symbol and Freemasonry as nonreligious, with members directed to their own faiths. appearances.snippet: Freemasons worship Solomon as the master architect. They believe that he gave them the keys to build and therefore control societies.

links.title: What led here and what followed
